title: 1. Soul Archive
description: Absorbed Essences appear in your Soul Archive. Select your archived Essence to view it and prepare it for your active loadout.

title: 2. Equip your Essence
description: Equip your first Essence. It will provide its abilities during combat after you save the loadout.

title: 3. Save your loadout
description: Your draft has unsaved changes. Save the loadout to attune the Essence and make its abilities available in combat.
